notes: «عن أخيه، خالد بن قيس» is one link, the name alone (rule 7). The text joins the name to the next preposition («خالد بن قيسعن قتادة»): read as «خالد بن قيس» then «قتادة», and raised as a text defect.

fixes.reason: The stored text runs the name into the next preposition, so the name's end and «عن» are not separated.
